item.title: Fire board approves emergency generator, tech upgrades
item.description: GILLETTE, Wyo. — The Campbell County Fire Board approved several budget changes and reviewed a recent wildfire response during its latest meeting. The board approved an amended fiscal year 2025 budget that increases spending by $1,086,382. The changes include an extra $85,000 for dispatch services to meet national standards and $76,974 for improved IT services.
